# Pitex 1.1.5

The Pitex Agent now installs on Macs and PCs that have neither Bun nor
Node.js. Pitex downloads its own Node.js when it needs one.

## Fixes

- When no Bun or Node.js is found, Pitex downloads Node.js 24.22.2 from
  nodejs.org (about 55 MB), checks it against a SHA-256 pinned in the
  app, and uses it to install the Pitex Agent. Your own Bun or Node.js
  is still used when present.
- A system Node.js older than 22.19, such as Ubuntu's packaged one or an
  old Homebrew install, is replaced by the pinned Node.js instead of
  failing the agent install.
- The Assistant shows an Install Pitex Agent button when the agent
  runtime is missing or its install failed, so you can retry.

## Install

Pitex 1.0.0 through 1.1.4 update to 1.1.5 from Settings or, with automatic
installation enabled, at launch. For Homebrew installations, run
`brew update` and `brew upgrade --cask pitex`.

Builds from the earlier 2.x line do not update automatically; install 1.1.5
from the downloads below. Pitex Nightly continues to use its separate
update channel.

## Downloads

Downloads include the macOS ARM64 DMG, Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04 AMD64 DEBs,
Windows AMD64 installer and portable ZIP, the Ubuntu installer, and
SHA256SUMS.
Windows remains beta.
